Step-by-Step Guide

Tap any step timer to launch Cook Mode right there

restaurant_menu
1

Preheat Oven & Prep Your Pan

Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C) and line your baking pan with parchment paper, leaving a slight overhang for effortless lifting. Measure out 3 pcs firm-ripe bananas (halved lengthwise) and 1/2 cup butter + dark brown sugar + cinnamon so everything is ready and at room temperature for a silky, lump-free batter.

2

Sizzle Bananas in Brown Butter Caramel

Melt 1/2 cup butter + dark brown sugar + cinnamon in a wide skillet until bubbling caramel, lay 3 pcs firm-ripe bananas (halved lengthwise) cut-side down 2 mins per side until glossy, and spoon hot over 4 scoops vanilla bean ice cream.

lightbulb
Creator Secret

Pre-chill your serving bowls or glasses in the freezer for 10 minutes for instant cafe presentation.

3

Bake Caramel Rum Bananas Foster Skillet & Check Doneness

Bake for 6 minutes until the edges turn golden and set while the center remains tender. Test with a toothpick—if it comes out with a few moist crumbs rather than wet batter, it is ready.

4

Cool Completely, Garnish & Serve

Transfer Caramel Rum Bananas Foster Skillet to a wire cooling rack and let it cool for 15–20 minutes so the interior sets cleanly without crumbling. Lift out using the parchment overhang, garnish as desired, and slice into 4 portions.

Nutrition, Storage & Healthy Prep Notes

CALORIES335 kcal
SERVINGS4
SUGAR MODEClassic

Make-Ahead & Storage: Keep caramel rum bananas foster skillet in an airtight glass container in the refrigerator for up to 4 days (or freeze individual portions up to 1 month). Pair with unsweetened Greek yogurt, fresh berries, or espresso for a balanced treat.

Keto & Low-Sugar Tip: Toggle Healthy Swap above to substitute refined sugar with monk fruit or coconut sugar and white flour with oat or almond flour.
